item.content:encoded:
My two least favorite characters in Resurrection are Adams and Foxx. This tale warmed me up to them, so very well done there.

I sort of wish there'd been a little more in the information revealed, since "Back Alley Deals" already namedropped Bowe. I know it makes sense in universe that this information would be revealed, it's just a tad underwhelming from the reader's point of view. That's pretty much my only gripe, as the rest of the tale had me both caring about characters I'd previously thought uninteresting and also interested in the politics of MC&D. The email at the end is a perfect cliffhanger/hint as well.

A well earned +1 from me.
